name.full: three.ws 3D Studio: text and photo to 3D

description.short: Generate, rig and view 3D models and avatars from text or a photo.
description.full: three.ws 3D Studio gives Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio agents tools that turn a plain-language request or a photo into a textured, downloadable GLB 3D model, auto-rig it for animation, find ready-made CC0 assets, and open the result in an interactive viewer. The free tools need no account. Generation takes 30 to 300 seconds, so the generate tool returns a job id and a second tool checks the job. Two personal tabs open the three.ws 3D viewer and a live directory of three.ws agents inside Microsoft 365, the Agents search command shares any agent as a live card in a chat, and the Create a 3D model action (or the forge bot command) generates a model in the conversation on a card that updates itself when the model is ready. Added to a meeting, the review stage puts one 3D model on the shared meeting stage for everyone: follow the presenter's camera or look around freely, point with a live laser, pin comments to the mesh and export them as markdown, and keep animation playback in sync.
